In detail

Repeatedly described by Swiss media as one of Zurich's more troubled areas, with reports of youth violence in recent years. Of little touristic relevance, but included for full city coverage.

This link is already scoped to this area (not the whole city), using the neighbourhood's real coordinates.

Risk levels for Zurich are a qualitative judgment call based on general knowledge and public reputation of each neighbourhood, not an official geolocated crime dataset — unlike London, no open municipal dataset at this level of detail exists yet for Zurich.
Real official data point: Schwamendingen-Mitte sits in Kreis 12, one of Zurich's 12 police districts. Kantonspolizei Zürich recorded an average burglary rate of 2.9 per 1,000 residents there across 3 years (2025, 2024, 2023), 28% of the 12-district average of 10.23/1,000. This figure is real, current, and official — but it covers burglaries only (not the full range of crime types) and is reported at the district level, not for Schwamendingen-Mitte specifically, so treat it as directional context for the wider area rather than a rating of this exact neighbourhood.
